root_review.review_result: All11 selected evidence raw byte lengths and SHA256s independently matched. Full inspection package pages1,5,6,7, well pages1,2, operator response pages1,2 and LED release page1 visually inspected. Official LDEQ notice and issuer named current-construction paragraph and annual successor passages read independently. OSM ordered nodes reproduce the valid source polygon and Shapely representative point exactly. Unknown-datum well point is corroboration only, not transformed geometry. Official-original byte matching of rehosted records remains unverified; signed letters, contacts and media are not distributed.
root_review.dedup: All138 prior campus keys and names compared; DF1/Boyce/AEX01/AEX02 are unrepresented. Nearest prior AVAIO Taurus about270.2km, followed by TRG Spring Cypress about302.5km. One campus including buildings and construction wells; not the old Alexandria locality point.
